verdict.rationale: USCIS's own site says it hosts a section of "reports, studies, and data on various aspects on USCIS operations," which suggests first-party published data. Nothing shows these are bulk, machine-readable downloads that avoid scraping. The Torch APIs are per-case status and FOIA rails, not bulk extracts, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented bulk dataset downloads (CSV/JSON files or extracts), case or wage statistics files, format and update-cadence documentation, and hands-on corroboration that the data is retrievable without scraping.

support.subject: As a developer, the service publishes bulk public-data downloads or extracts (datasets, registry extracts, wage or case statistics) that need no scraping

citations.quote: This section contains reports, studies, and data on various aspects on USCIS operations.
